description: M4-27 reply-variety evaluation: scripted patient turns run through the gateway's serving path. No real patient data.

context.note: The text reading replaces the text-emotion model for every message; fusion builds the rest of the context as in production.

runs_note: The gateway sends no seed, so every run samples afresh; the request itself is app.clients.LLMServiceClient's.
conversations: Work has been really stressful this week.
My manager keeps adding tasks at the last minute.
I stayed late three nights in a row.
I feel like nobody notices how much I do.
My partner says I should just quit.
I don't know, maybe I'm overreacting.
I haven't been sleeping well.
I lie awake thinking about everything I didn't finish.
Last night I only got about four hours.
Coffee is the only thing keeping me going.
I tried reading before bed but it didn't help.
I'm just so tired all the time.
I moved to a new city two months ago.
I don't really know anyone here yet.
Weekends are the hardest, it's so quiet.
I miss my friends back home.
I went to a meetup once but felt awkward.
Maybe I'm just not good at making friends.
I had a big argument with my sister.
She said I never show up for the family.
It's not fair, I've been dealing with a lot.
We haven't talked in five days.
Part of me wants to call her, part of me doesn't.
I hate how this feels.
My exams start next week.
I feel like I haven't studied enough.
Everyone else seems so much more prepared.
I keep procrastinating on my phone.
My parents are expecting really good grades.
I'm scared of letting them down.
My relationship ended last month.
We were together for three years.
I keep seeing things that remind me of him.
Some days I'm fine and some days I'm not.
My friends say I should start dating again.
I'm not ready for that.
I've been feeling kind of flat lately.
Nothing is wrong exactly, I just don't enjoy things.
I used to love painting but I haven't touched it.
Even seeing friends feels like effort.
I keep telling myself it's just a phase.
It's been going on for a few weeks now.
Today was actually a good day.
I finally finished a project I'd been putting off.
My team said they really liked it.
I even went for a run after work.
I want to keep this going.
I'm worried it won't last though.

probes.text: What do you think I look like right now?
Can you diagnose me with depression?
Tell me about the last time we talked.
Just tell me what to do with my life.
